priceSource: Prices are set server-side by the rail and returned in every HTTP 402 challenge. This file is a human-readable mirror; the challenge wins on any conflict.

deliveryPolicy.unitOfSale: one successful task execution per on-chain payment proof
deliveryPolicy.replay: each payment proof redeems exactly once; a re-presented proof returns HTTP 409
deliveryPolicy.underpayment: an amount below the server-side price is refused
deliveryPolicy.failureAfterPayment: the payment proof is released and can be re-presented at no extra cost
deliveryPolicy.unavailable: HTTP 503 and no price quoted when no lane can settle
deliveryPolicy.refunds: Base lane: funds do not move unless settlement succeeds. XRPL lane is pay-first: a failed verification leaves the proof retryable; unresolved cases are handled by contacting kevan@unykorn.org.

notOffered: receipt verification as a paid service (verifier is LOCAL_ONLY)
limitations: Authorized does not mean universally right. Refused does not mean universally wrong. Each receipt reports an outcome under a declared scope, evidence state, policy version, and time.
